meta.name: business-context-loader
meta.description: Load and progressively fill the business-context file for a company you run (operator companies only). Say "load context for <company>", "what's next on <company>", "what's stale on <company>", or "give me an action on <company>". Reads `companies/<slug>-business.md` (derived from `templates/business-context.template.md`). Adapts to whatever state the file is in (empty, partial, mostly-filled, stale) and routes the founder to the next highest-impact move. Mirrors the brand-interview / voice-interview pattern but for company context, not personal voice. For prospect companies (companies you sell to or watch), use `prospect-init` instead - the path convention is `companies/prospects/<slug>.md`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。
